highlights.text: Support-agent benchmarks overstate deflection: most count containment without checking resolution. Across eleven vendors, contained tickets reopened 18 to 26% of the time. Ask for the reopen rate before believing any deflection headline.

results.author: Fictional Ship It Weekly

highlights.text: We shipped a support copilot on a 38% deflection pilot and spent the next quarter re-queueing reopened tickets by hand. The pilot counted containment: no human reply in 24 hours. Nobody sampled resolution until after GA, when the reopen rate turned out to be one in four.

results.title: We Shipped a Support Copilot on Vibes

highlights.text: The staff engineer's reading problem is not volume, it is retrieval: forty tabs of evals research help nothing if none of it surfaces in the review where it matters. Keep one page per decision with the assertion, the counter-evidence, and the opening question.
